text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — sev:high — service=redwood-runtime inference-pool-46 — symptom=nccl_collective_hang detected, 4 GPUs blocked, error pattern: timeout/comm-reset. Trace: /services/runtime/collectives/nccl (alert rule: nccl.hang.v1) 

oncall_reza: ack. I'm on it. Booting vpn, grabbing logs. 

arya_infra: seen this earlier today on pool-32. Quick check: node ip 10.3.12.46 reported kernel OOMs around the same time? Can you post nvidia-smi and dmesg. 

matt_runtime: adding context — pattern looks like multi-gpu allreduce hang during model forward with TP=2/PP=1. We should try diverting traffic off this pool and restart runtime processes to avoid cascading customer errors. 

sam_engineer: copying commands: 
```
# check pods
kubectl get pods -n redwood-runtime -o wide | grep inference-pool-46
# check GPU status
kubectl exec -n redwood-runtime <pod> -- nvidia-smi -q | head -n 80
# kernel logs
kubectl logs -n kube-system <node-exporter-pod> --since=10m | grep -i 'oom\|NVRM\|Xid'
```

oncall_reza: ran nvidia-smi on pod runtime-46-a -> GPUs 0..3 show compute running but no forward progress, memory usage ~95% all GPUs. dmesg contains repeated: `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus`. Looks like a GPU error followed by NCCL timeouts. 

arya_infra: urgent mitigation plan: 1) scale down and drain node (cordon) 2) restart runtime container on other nodes 3) route traffic to fallback single-gpu variant / cheaper model variant.

matt_runtime: I'll flip routing in the console now to reduce requests to pool-46. Steps: 
- in console -> routes -> inference-prod -> set weight: pool-46 0, pool-41 100 (takes effect immediate). 
- if console blocked, run `redwoodctl route update --route inference-prod --set pool-46=0`

cs_amy: customer impact: monitoring shows elevated 5xxs for tenant_ids t-231, t-998, t-44 starting 00:02UTC. Estimated 3 customers impacted, ~12req/min failing. Let me open a notification ticket to CS. 

oncall_reza: cordoned node 10.3.12.46 and drained pods: `kubectl cordon node/np-46 && kubectl drain node/np-46 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — some pods evicted. Restarting runtime agent on evicted pods. 

sam_engineer: while draining, we should avoid mass restarts that cause cold cache loss. Prefer restarting only the runtime process: `kubectl exec <pod> -- pkill -f redwood-runtime && sleep 30 && kubectl rollout status ds/redwood-runtime` 

matt_runtime: restarted runtime on two affected pods. Observed NCCL communicator resets in logs: `ncclCommInitRank failed: unhandled cuda error` followed by `collective timeout`. 

oncall_reza: after restarts, one pod recovered, two pods still show hang. Planning node reboot for np-46 to clear GPU driver state; requesting maintenance window 5m. 

arya_infra: agree. Rebooting node (soft) now: `gcloud compute instances reset np-46` (on-prem clusters use ipmitool). Will monitor for NVidia driver reattachment. 

incident-bot: escalation -> hw-oncall paged (sev:high) due to GPU XID 79s. 

matt_runtime: after reboot, GPUs reappeared, NVidia driver loaded, `nvidia-smi` shows healthy. Restarted runtime pods back onto node and slowly unrolled. Running smoke evals on model path: 20/20 passes. 

cs_amy: customers t-231 and t-998 acknowledged degraded behavior; CS notified them of mitigation and ETA. No data leakage. 

oncall_reza: follow-ups: 1) upload full logs to incident ticket INC-2023-3467 (link) 2) run kernel and driver diag to root cause — schedule hardware swap if Xid recurs 3) add temporary routing rule to prefer single-gpu variant for mem-heavy models during next 24h. 

sam_engineer: added temporary rule: inference-prod weight: pool-46=0, pool-41=80, fallback-single-gpu=20. Will revert after stabilization. 

arya_infra: proposed runbook updates: add step to check for GPU Xids and prefer node reboot over container-only restart if Xid present. Filing PR: /docs/runbooks/nccl-collective-hang.md. 

matt_runtime: root cause hypothesis: a GPU driver or firmware transient produced Xid 79 causing one GPU to drop; NCCL didn't gracefully recover communicator causing hang across the communicator. Action items: FW update on nodes with repeated Xid, add NCCL timeout metric alert earlier, and improve worker-level watchdog that can fall back to single-GPU model when collective health degrades. 

oncall_reza: wrapping up — incident resolved at 00:18UTC, last_message_ts=1933456910. I'm adding timeline + mitigations to the ticket and assigning follow-ups to infra/matt. If anyone sees recurring Xid on other pools ping infra. :thumbsup: 

incident-bot: Created incident INC-2023-3467, severity downgraded to mitigated.
